pure-announcement.rationale: Vendor content, but built around a structural argument rather than a release.

duplicate.rationale: No SIEM or agent-observability concept exists in this corpus.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The central gap claim is grounded in the linked OWASP Agentic Top 10 (2026) and NIST AI RMF, both primary and checkable.

durability.rationale: The mechanism-level claim — SIEMs correlate structured telemetry and cannot see semantic content or causal tool chains, so agentic attacks spanning multi-step loops go unlogged — holds independent of the vendor pitching it.

actionability.rationale: The transferable practice (log full tool chains with causal links, map events to OWASP agentic categories) is present but thin; much of the how is the vendor's product.

atomicity.rationale: One idea: the SIEM visibility gap for agentic AI.
